parameters.name: confidence_threshold
parameters.label: Confidence Threshold
parameters.description: Detections with confidence below this value are discarded (Confidence Filtering).

parameters.name: density_unit
parameters.label: Density Unit
parameters.description: Unit used for the tree density metric.

parameters.name: detector
parameters.label: Detection Model
parameters.description: Detection backend. 'opencv_watershed' is the built-in crown detector (Excess Green, Otsu, distance-transform peaks); 'stub' returns no detections and only exercises the pipeline.

parameters.name: iou_threshold
parameters.label: Duplicate Overlap (IoU)
parameters.description: Overlapping boxes above this IoU are treated as the same tree (de-duplication across tiles).

parameters.name: tile_size
parameters.label: Tile Size (px)
parameters.description: Size of the square tiles the image is split into before inference.

parameters.name: gsd_cm
parameters.label: Ground Sampling Distance (cm/px)
parameters.description: Used only when the image metadata has no gsd_m value.
